population.definition: lemma|pos pairs of the content parts of speech (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) that have a kaikki lemma entry and at least one word form in the FrequencyWords list; a word form shared by several lemma entries (any part of speech) splits its count in proportion to each entry's richness (lemma senses + examples + 5 when it has an inflection table), and a closed-class lemma identical to the form absorbs the whole count; lemmas with an upper-case initial (proper nouns, abbreviations — except German nouns), single letters and letter/note names are excluded; per-million is relative to the FrequencyWords list total

freqLemme.unit: occurrences per million words of the FrequencyWords list

bandRule: very-common = perMillion ≥ p99 of the population; common = ≥ p95; less-common = the rest (identical rule to the French Lexique derivation)
